prompt.reglas:
Illustrious (WAI-illustrious-SDXL): an anime illustration model trained on Danbooru tags.
Write Danbooru tags, most important first: the count and subject (1girl, 2boys, solo), the character name with the series in parentheses as on Danbooru (hatsune miku (vocaloid)), then hair, eyes, clothes, pose, expression, setting, lighting and composition (upper body, from above, close-up).
Characters and Danbooru artist tags are known: use an artist tag only if the request names that artist or style.
Do not add quality or aesthetic tags: the system already adds them, and more of them make the image blurry.
Keep the negative short or empty: long negatives make the image worse.
For an older look of a character, when the request asks for one, start with (mature female:1.2) or (aged up:1.2).
